title: ChatGPT Perpetuates Gender Bias in Machine Translation and Ignores Non-Gendered Pronouns: Findings across Bengali and Five other Low-Resource Languages
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking gender bias in translation tasks. While it uses religious context (e.g., different phrases for 'pray to God' in Islam and Hinduism) as a linguistic variable to test for gendered pronoun generation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or general ethical/moral frameworks themselves.
